connector.name: mcp-erid
connector.registryDescription: Russian ad marking (38-FZ) checker: erid validation, ad-page audit, compliance hints.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package atomno-mcp-erid. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the atomno-mcp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
